text:
Mike L: hey team — got my MacBook and trying to finish Okta setup. Okta Verify installed but I never get the push to my Apple Watch when I try to enroll Device Trust. Also my 1Password seat doesn't show up yet. who should I ping? :wave:
Carmen (IT): hey @Mike L — sorry about that. quick q: did you enroll the laptop to our MDM (Jamf) during first-boot? you should have seen a "Company Device" prompt.
Mike L: i did the initial setup but i might have skipped one prompt. the watch shows in bluetooth and works for Apple Pay.
it-bot: Laptop imaging complete — serial: C02XXXXXXX. Okta account created for mike@example.com.
Carmen (IT): thanks. two likely issues: Device Trust failing if the machine isn't enrolled in MDM, or push notifications blocked by firewall on the network. steps: 1) open System Settings > Profiles and confirm "Company Management" profile exists. 2) in Okta web UI try "Send Push" again. 3) if no push, connect to home network or phone hotspot and retry.
Mike L: i checked Profiles — there is no company profile. i used the office wifi earlier but not now.
Carmen (IT): ok that explains it. can you do this: 1) connect to a phone hotspot, 2) open https://onboard.redwood.internal/enroll and follow the MDM prompt, 3) restart and then try Okta Verify. if it still fails, DM me a screenshot of the enrollment error and the laptop serial.
Jamie (DevEx): if you need immediate access, we can enable a temporary TOTP for your Okta account and push a 1Password seat manually. to use TOTP in 1Password: open 1Password > Accounts > Sign in with SSO, or if seat not provisioned i'll add a software TOTP secret to your onboarding ticket.
Mike L: serial is C02ABC12345. attaching screenshot: https://files.redwood.com/attachments/2078901234/okta-error.png
Carmen (IT): got it. creating a support ticket now. ticket #IT-2145 — I'll push a temporary 1Password seat and MDM invite. ETA ~20–30m. in the meantime, Jamie — please add the TOTP secret if possible.
Jamie (DevEx): adding TOTP to IT-2145 now. also FYI if you run into App Store issues, you can install Okta Verify from the company Self-Service app.
Mike L: awesome, thanks both. will try the hotspot now. :thumbsup:
Carmen (IT): cool — ping here when MDM shows the profile. if enrollment fails, we'll do a remote assist.
Mike L: profile showed up after hotspot and enroll link. Okta push now works and watch prompt appeared. 1Password seat worked too. thanks! :tada:
Carmen (IT): sweet — marking ticket IT-2145 resolved. welcome aboard! :party_parrot:
